result.brief: 对驾驶视频扩散模型进行系统缩放律研究，给出模型规模与训练曝光的最优分配，并训练出 9B 参数开源 SOTA 驾驶视频生成模型。
result.reason: Systematic scaling-law study of video diffusion models trained from scratch on driving data, with 9B model and open-source SOTA driving video generation; directly informs video generation training and scaling.
